prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right agency depends on your industry, goals, budget, and which services you need (branding, digital advertising, SEO, social, PR, B2B, etc.). That said, a few Kansas City agencies are widely respected and frequently recommended:

- Barkley — large independent full-service creative and advertising shop known for big-brand campaigns and strong creative work.  
- VMLY&R (VM R&Y) — global integrated agency with strong digital, brand and experience capabilities; Kansas City is an important market for them.  
- Martin Williams — established regional agency focused on strategy, branding and integrated marketing.

If you tell me what you need (examples: lead generation vs. brand building, expected monthly/annual budget, industry, timeline, whether you want local or national reach), I can:
- Recommend 3–5 agencies in KC that match your needs, with why each is a fit, or  
- Draft an RFP or list of questions to ask agencies, or  
- Walk you through how to evaluate proposals and check references.

If you’d like, give me those details and I’ll put together a tailored shortlist.
